title: smtp/server.rs credential loading uses deprecated if let Some(ref path) pattern
description: crates/smtp/src/server.rs build_credential_store block uses 'if let Some(ref path) = config.auth.credential_file' — the pre-NLL idiom. imap and reader were updated to 'if let Some(path) = &config.auth.credential_file' as part of aubi. smtp was not. Clippy's redundant_pattern_matching lint catches this. Change to 'if let Some(path) = &config.auth.credential_file' for consistency.
